assessments.zone: Villages of Kingandu secteur in the west of the territory (Kingandu health zone: Kinzuku, Ngula, Kabudi, Kindembe, Kanga Nzadi, etc.)
assessments.evidence: Rural villages under customary chiefs within state authority, with PNC posts at secteur level. This is the part of the territory closest to the Mobondo-affected areas but no Mobondo presence or raids are reported here. No source reports armed-group activity in this area as of the reference date; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge, Kwango) lies well to the west/north-west of Gungu territory. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked).

units.CD3210-gungu: Gungu territory (Kwilu) covers Gungu town and the Gungu, Mukedi and Kingandu secteurs between the Kwilu and Kasai-border areas south of Kikwit. No armed group is reported to control or regularly raid any locality here; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge, Kwango) lies to the west. All locations are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as the main permanent force and customary chiefs under it. Live web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for Gungu town and low elsewhere. A skeptical review (2026-10-01) could not run independent web searches either (search budget exhausted, search engines blocked by proxy); zone assignments were checked against adm3/health-zone data and the default-state-presence assessment is retained unverified, consistent with neighbouring Idiofa units.
